name: Ashes: Blackwater
summary: Ashes Blackwater is an addon for Ashes: Afterglow and Ashes: Hard Reset. Though it features no new maps, Blackwater offers a different spin on 6 maps from Afterglow and Hard Reset which now form a cohesive hub structure. It features an arsenal comprised mostly of Afterglow guns with two returning weapons from Hard Reset and a certain weapon from Dead Man Walking, though behaving slightly differently and with its very own new upgrade path.
